name: film
description: Animated-film light: warm key from front-left, cool fill, a back kick that makes edges glow, shadows as deep as the plain look's with little wrap, a key 60 degrees up and a soft ambient so dark stone and turned-away faces keep mid-tones; a softer, hue-keeping tonemap that keeps white off the clip so glows stay orange; exposure set so the scene keeps the plain look's brightness; skin with a soft warm terminator, wet eyes with a catchlight. Same params and shaders as the plain look; only values differ.
